title: Omnilor
overview: A safety dashboard that helps teams understand locations, risks, and incidents through a clearer spatial interface.
challenge: Designing a clear, well-structured dashboard while ensuring effective collaboration between design and development.
approach: I worked on structuring the dashboard interface, organizing UI components, and preparing design specifications for developer handoff. I also collaborated with team members to align on design decisions and support a smoother workflow.
learned: I gained experience in dashboard design, developer handoff, and team collaboration. I learned the importance of clear communication, organized design files, and aligning design decisions with the team throughout the workflow.
